title: 2021年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2021年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay titled “Doviolent video games lead to violence?”. The statement given below is for your reference. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words . A growing body of research finds that violent video games can make kids act aggressively in their real world relationships, causing an increase in violence.
reference: Do violent video games lead to violence? While a growing body of research suggests such games can make players more aggressive, I believe they do not directly cause real violence; rather, their influence depends on the individual and the surrounding environment. To begin with, exposure to violent scenes may indeed shape behavior. First, children who spend hours shooting and fighting on screen can gradually treat aggression as normal, and some may copy what they see when they lose their temper. However, most players clearly separate games from reality. A well-supervised teenager, for instance, can enjoy an action game after homework and still behave kindly toward classmates, because family guidance and self-control matter far more than the game itself. In conclusion, violent video games alone do not turn ordinary people into violent ones. What truly counts is proper parental supervision and healthy habits. Therefore, rather than simply blaming the games, parents and schools should teach children to play in moderation and to tell fantasy from real life.
keyPoints: 首段落实开门见山亮立场。开头 'Do violent video games lead to violence?' 用问句引 题，'While a growing body of research suggests...' 用 While 让步嵌入研究，'I believe they do not directly cause real violence' 一句亮出辩证立场，正好落实 outline 第一段的『引题表态』。

主体段走完让步-反例。'To begin with, exposure to violent scenes may indeed shape behavior' 先让步承认坏处，'However, most players clearly separate games from reality' 转折，再 用 'A well-supervised teenager, for instance...' 举例回扣中心，观点-理由-例证-回扣四步齐全。

尾段重申加建议。'In conclusion, violent video games alone do not turn ordinary people into violent ones' 换词重申立场，'Therefore, rather than simply blaming the games, parents and schools should teach children to play in moderation' 给出可操作建议，收束有力。
